title: 5'RACE (Rapid Amplification of cDNA ends) Protocol
author: Anna Behle

RppH removes pyrophosphate from triphosphorylated ends of mRNA (primary transcripts in bacteria). +RppH: Both Both primary (formerly triphosphorylated) and degraded RNA can be linked to the adapter. -RppH: Only degraded (pyrophosphate removed) can be linked to adapter. + Alkaline phosphatase: Negative control; no ligation possible because all 5'phosphates are removed. 1 2 3 +RppH -RppH +FastAP 5µg DNase-treated RNA 5µg DNase-treated RNA 5µg DNase-treated RNA 10 µL 10x NEB 2 buffer 10 µL 10x NEB 2 buffer 10 µL 10x FastAP buffer 5 µL RppH 5 µL H2O 5 µL FastAP 1 µL RNase Inhibitor 1 µL RNase Inhibitor 1 µL RNase Inhibitor H2O ad 100 µL H2O ad 100 µL H2O ad 100 µL Incubate for 1 h at 37˚C. Possible positive control: +PNK: labels all dephosphorylated mRNA with a 5' phosphate. When working with eukaryotic RNA, RppH can also be used for decapping, but NEB 10x Thermopol buffer needs to be purchased instead of NEBuffer 2. steps.title: Culture cells and extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Prepare a bacterial culture under the desired conditions (e.g., high salt, oxidative stress), harvest the cells, and extract total RNA from Synechocystis using the PGTX method (Anna Behle).

steps.title: Precipitate RNA (first purification)
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol Roti Aqua P/C/I (Carl Roth Cat #X985.1) to the RNA solution, mix well, and centrifuge at 4 °C for 10 min at maximum speed. Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube, add 1/10 vol 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.3) and 3 vol 100 % EtOH, then precipitate at –20 °C overnight. Centrifuge 30 min at maximum speed and 4 °C, discard the supernatant, wash the pellet with 500 µL 70 % EtOH, centrifuge 15 min at 4 °C (max speed), remove all supernatant, dry the pellet for 5 min, and resuspend the RNA in 60 µL RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Ligate RNA‑oligo linker
steps.instruction: Prepare the 5´‑RNA‑oligo linker (sequence GUGAUCCAACCGACGCGACAAGCUAAUGCAAGANNN) with a non‑phosphorylated 5´ end. Add T4 RNA Ligase 1 (1 000 U, NEB Cat #M0204S) and incubate for 1 h at 37 °C (or 12 h at 17 °C) to ligate the linker to the RNA, preventing undesired ligation to the mRNA 3´ end.

steps.title: Second RNA precipitation and cDNA resuspension
steps.instruction: Add 1 vol Roti Aqua P/C/I, mix, and centrifuge at 4 °C for 10 min at maximum speed. Transfer to a fresh tube, add 1/10 vol 3 M NaOAc (pH 5.3), 3 vol 100 % EtOH, and 1 µL glycogen (ThermoScientific, RNA‑grade). Precipitate at –20 °C overnight or at least 1 h at –80 °C. Centrifuge 30 min at maximum speed and 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash the pellet with 500 µL 70 % EtOH, centrifuge 15 min at 4 °C (max speed), remove all supernatant, dry for 5 min, and resuspend the cDNA in 21 µL RNase‑free water.

steps.title: RNase H treatment
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase H (250 U, NEB Cat #M0297S) to the sample and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Amplify with Q5 PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 25 µL Q5 PCR: 5 µL 5× Q5 reaction buffer, 5 µL 5× High‑GC buffer, 0.5 µL Adapter‑Primer 1, 0.5 µL nested gene‑specific primer, 0.5 µL dNTPs, 4 µL cDNA, 0.5 µL Q5 polymerase, and water to 25 µL. Cycle: 98 °C 2 min; 30‑35 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, xx °C 5 s, 72 °C 10 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min. Include a control PCR on DNase‑treated RNA to check for genomic DNA contamination.

steps.title: Gel electrophoresis and band extraction
steps.instruction: Run PCR products on a 1.8 % agarose gel for ~1.5 h (or on a 3 % NuSieve agarose gel for very small fragments). Visualize bands; if an RppH⁺‑specific band is present, excise the highest‑molecular‑weight band and gel‑extract it. If needed, perform an additional nested PCR. Analyze all specific bands when multiple are observed.

steps.title: Subclone into vector and transform
steps.instruction: Ligate the RACE‑PCR fragment into a cloning vector of choice (e.g., pJET or TOPO) and transform competent E. coli DH5α cells with the ligation mix.

steps.title: Colony PCR and sequencing
steps.instruction: Perform colony PCR on transformant colonies to confirm insertion. Purify plasmids from positive colonies and sequence them. Analyze at least five clones (more if desired).
